exposure: Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) treatments (intrauterine insemination, in vitro fertilization)
cohort: The study cohort comprised 269,930 women in Korea who gave birth in 2018, identified from the National Health Insurance Service National Delivery Cohort.
finding: In vitro fertilization was associated with a 1.5-fold higher risk of severe maternal morbidity in both singleton and multiple births, whereas intrauterine insemination showed no significant association.
